cropGuidance: Landscape 3:2 original; central composition supports 16:10 cover crops. Inspect narrower crops separately.
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: original fine-art cover illustration for a piano practice app's Library, not an album mockup. Create an edge-to-edge landscape 3:2 painting, ideally 1536×1024. Scene: one solitary small dancer in an airy sunlit courtyard, a long still shadow extending across pale stone. The figure is poised in a calm balanced stance, not a dramatic leap. Airy rose and sage architecture, warm soft sunlight, quiet open space. Feeling: slow spacious balance and unhurried grace. Medium: sophisticated tactile editorial gouache, fine-art album-sleeve painting, matte pigments, visible fine paper grain and elegant layered brushwork. A richly painted but restrained palette of dusty rose, muted sage and warm ivory; distinct figure/shadow silhouette legible at thumbnail scale. The dancer and complete important portion of the long shadow stay inside the central 70% of the canvas, with architecture loosely framing generous space, so full 3:2 and slightly cropped 16:10 both work. No border, no frame, no text, no lettering, no logos, no watermark, no musical notation, no interface. No piano or instruments. Original artistic interpretation, no famous painting imitation.
editPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this exact illustration only to remove the tiny signature-like dark mark in the extreme bottom-left corner. Replace that mark with the same painted pale stone/paper texture of its immediate surroundings. Preserve everything else exactly: dancer, anatomy, pose, face, long shadow, courtyard, architecture, palette, brushwork, composition, lighting and image size. Do not add any text, signature, watermark or logo anywhere. This must remain an edge-to-edge original painting.
qualityReview: Passed final after one edit removed a tiny signature-like lower-left mark. Dancer and long shadow remain legible, rose/sage/ivory courtyard retains spacious balance. Final has no visible text, logos or watermarks.
